descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) e Talent Management (Ashore) è responsabile per la definizione e la guida della strategia globale per l'apprendimento e lo sviluppo su entrambi i dipendenti della nave e della riva, mentre supervisiona Talent Management e la pianificazione di successo per le popolazioni a base di riva. Il ruolo assicura che l'azienda sviluppi le capacità necessarie per offrire esperienze ospiti eccezionali, l'eccellenza operativa e una forte leadership in una forza lavoro globale, tra cui migliaia di equipaggio di bordo e una diversa organizzazione a base di riva. Per i dipendenti di bordo, il ruolo si concentra sulla costruzione di capacità operative e di servizio di livello mondiale attraverso la formazione strutturata, lo sviluppo di leadership e le strutture di progressione di carriera che supportano le prestazioni della flotta e la soddisfazione degli ospiti. Per i dipendenti a base di riva, il ruolo guida sia Learning & Development che Talent Management, tra cui sviluppo di leadership, pianificazione di successione e sviluppo di talenti pipeline per ruoli di leadership aziendale e operativa. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i leader operativi senior in Operazioni, Esperienza degli Ospiti e Funzioni aziendali, questo ruolo guida una cultura dell’apprendimento continuo, dell’eccellenza della leadership e della capacità organizzativa attraverso le operazioni globali dell’azienda. Il tuo impatto Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore) - Definire e implementare la strategia globale di apprendimento e sviluppo che copre sia l'equipaggio di bordo che i dipendenti a base di riva. - Sviluppare un ecosistema di apprendimento integrato che supporta l'eccellenza operativa a bordo e la capacità di leadership a terra. - Assicurarsi che le iniziative di apprendimento supportino direttamente le priorità strategiche come: - eccellenza dell'esperienza degli ospiti - sicurezza e conformità - prestazioni operative - efficacia della leadership - trasformazione digitale e commerciale - Superare i quadri di bordo e di sviluppo per accelerare l'integrazione e le prestazioni dei dipendenti sia in ambienti di bordo che in riva. - Guidare l'adozione di approcci di apprendimento moderni, tra cui apprendimento digitale, formazione basata sulla simulazione, microlearning e soluzioni di apprendimento misto. Imparare & Sviluppo - Guidare la progettazione e la consegna della strategia globale di apprendimento e sviluppo del bordo nave in tutta la flotta. - Collaborare a stretto contatto con Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage e Guest Experience per garantire ai programmi di formazione le priorità operative e l'eccellenza dei servizi. - Assicurare standard di formazione coerenti in tutta la flotta, accompagnando le realtà operative degli ambienti di bordo. - supervisionare i programmi di sviluppo per i ruoli chiave della nave, compresi i programmi di supervisione e sviluppo della gestione per i futuri leader a bordo. - Supporta percorsi di sviluppo di carriera strutturati per l'equipaggio di bordo, consentendo progressione interna attraverso l'ospitalità e le funzioni operative. - Assicurare l'allineamento con tutti i requisiti di formazione normativa marittima e standard di sicurezza. Apprendimento e sviluppo basati sugli urti - Guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione di programmi di apprendimento e sviluppo per i dipendenti basati sulla riva attraverso funzioni aziendali e operative. - Sviluppare iniziative di creazione di capacità a sostegno delle principali priorità aziendali come: - capacità commerciali - trasformazione digitale - eccellenza operativa - cultura guest-centric - Progettazione di programmi di sviluppo di leadership strutturati per leader emergenti, di medio livello e senior. - Sviluppare accademie funzionali e strutture di capacità che supportano le discipline aziendali critiche. Talent Management & Succession Planning (solo Ashore) - Definire e implementare la strategia globale di gestione del talento aziendale per i dipendenti a base di riva. - Processi di piombo per: - identificazione del talento e recensioni dei talenti - pianificazione di successione per ruoli di leadership critici - programmi di sviluppo ad alto potenziale - sviluppo delle pipeline di leadership - quadri di sviluppo della carriera - Partner con leadership esecutiva e HR Business Partners per garantire forti condutture di successione per le posizioni di leadership aziendali e operative chiave a terra. - Integrare le pratiche di gestione dei talenti nei quadri di gestione delle prestazioni e sviluppo della leadership. Sviluppo della leadership - Progettare e implementare programmi di sviluppo di leadership che supportano sia le popolazioni di leadership a bordo che a riva. - Stabilire un quadro di leadership globale allineato con i valori della società e la cultura guest-centric. - Rafforzare le capacità di leadership in settori come: - leadership della gente - processo decisionale operativo - servizio eccellenza - innovazione e miglioramento continuo - leadership interculturale Il tuo viaggio finora Istruzione - Laurea magistrale in Risorse Umane, Sviluppo Organizzativo, Business Administration, o relativo campo. Esperienza - 15+ anni di esperienza progressiva nell'apprendimento e nello sviluppo, nella gestione dei talenti o nello sviluppo organizzativo. - Esperienza significativa nella progettazione e nell'attuazione di strategie di apprendimento globali per le grandi forze di lavoro internazionali. - Esperienza comprovata leader nella gestione del talento e programmi di pianificazione di successione per le popolazioni di leadership aziendale. - Esperienza in crociera, ospitalità, viaggio, aviazione, o altre grandi organizzazioni di servizio fortemente preferito. - Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti altamente multiculturali e geograficamente distribuiti. Competenze chiave - Apprendimento Strategico & Capability Development - Gestione del talento e pianificazione della successione (Corporate) - Servizio Eccellenza e Cultura Ospitalità - Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership - Mindset globale e intelligenza culturale - Sviluppo organizzativo - Tecnologia di apprendimento e apprendimento digitale I tuoi essenziali - È richiesta una fluidità in inglese; italiano, francese, tedesco o altre lingue europee sono un plus. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only. The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization. For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction. For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles. Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations. Your Impact Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore) - Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees. - Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore. - Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as: - guest experience excellence - safety and compliance - operational performance - leadership effectiveness - digital and business transformation - Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments. - Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions. Shipboard Learning & Development - Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet. - Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence. - Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments. - Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders. - Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions. - Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards. Shore-Based Learning & Development - Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions. - Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as: - leadership effectiveness - commercial capabilities - digital transformation - operational excellence - guest-centric culture - Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders. - Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines. Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only) - Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees. - Lead processes for: - talent identification and talent reviews - succession planning for critical leadership roles - high-potential development programs - leadership pipeline development - career development frameworks - Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore. - Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks. Leadership Development - Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations. - Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture. - Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as: - people leadership - operational decision-making - service excellence - innovation and continuous improvement - cross-cultural leadership Your Journey so far Education - Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field. Experience - 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development. - Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces. - Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations. - Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred. - Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments. Key Competences - Strategic Learning & Capability Development - Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate) - Leadership Development - Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture - Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership - Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence - Organizational Development - Learning Technology & Digital Learning Your Essentials - Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
descriptionByLocale.de: Der Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) und Talent Management (Ashore) ist dafür verantwortlich, die globale Lern- und Entwicklungsstrategie sowohl für Mitarbeiter an Bord als auch an Land zu definieren und zu leiten, während er Talent Management und Nachfolgeplanung nur für an Land ansässige Bevölkerungen überwacht. Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass das Unternehmen die Fähigkeiten entwickelt, die erforderlich sind, um außergewöhnliche Gästeerlebnisse, operative Exzellenz und eine starke Führungsrolle in einer globalen Belegschaft zu bieten, darunter Tausende von Schiffsbesatzungen und eine vielfältige landgestützte Organisation. Für Mitarbeiter an Bord konzentriert sich die Rolle auf den Aufbau von erstklassigen Betriebs- und Servicefähigkeiten durch strukturierte Schulungen, Führungsentwicklung und Karriereentwicklungsrahmen, die die Leistung der Flotte und die Gästezufriedenheit unterstützen. Für Mitarbeiter an Land führt die Rolle sowohl Learning & Development als auch Talent Management, einschließlich Führungskräfteentwicklung, Nachfolgeplanung und Talent-Pipeline-Entwicklung für Unternehmens- und operative Führungsrollen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden operativen Führungskräften in den Bereichen Operations, Guest Experience und Corporate Functions treibt diese Rolle eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens, der Führungsqualität und des Aufbaus organisatorischer Fähigkeiten in den globalen Aktivitäten des Unternehmens voran. B.: - Gasterlebnisexzellenz - Sicherheit und Compliance - operative Leistung - Führungseffektivität - digitale und geschäftliche Transformation - Onboarding- und Entwicklungsrahmen überwachen, um die Integration und Leistung der Mitarbeiter sowohl an Bord als auch an Land zu beschleunigen. Shore-Based Learning & Development - Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Lern- und Entwicklungsprogrammen für Mitarbeiter an Land in allen Unternehmens- und Betriebsfunktionen. - Entwicklung von Initiativen zum Aufbau von Fähigkeiten, die wichtige Geschäftsprioritäten unterstützen, wie: - kommerzielle Fähigkeiten - digitale Transformation - operative Exzellenz - gastzentrierte Kultur - Strukturierte Führungsentwicklungsprogramme für aufstrebende, mittlere und leitende Führungskräfte entwerfen. - Entwicklung funktionaler Akademien und Fähigkeitsrahmen, die kritische Unternehmensdisziplinen unterstützen. Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only) - Definieren und implementieren Sie die globale Talentmanagement-Strategie des Unternehmens für Mitarbeiter an Land. - Lead-Prozesse für: - Talentidentifikation und Talentbewertungen - Nachfolgeplanung für kritische Führungsrollen - High-Potential-Entwicklungsprogramme - Leadership-Pipeline-Entwicklung - Karriereentwicklungsrahmen - Partnerschaft mit Executive Leadership und HR Business Partners, um starke Nachfolge-Pipelines für wichtige Unternehmens- und operative Führungspositionen an Land zu gewährleisten. - Einbetten von Talentmanagement-Praktiken in Performance-Management- und Führungskräfteentwicklungs-Frameworks. Etablieren Sie einen globalen Führungsrahmen, der auf die Werte des Unternehmens und die gastorientierte Kultur ausgerichtet ist. - Stärkung der Führungskompetenzen in Bereichen wie: - People Leadership - operative Entscheidungsfindung - Service Excellence - Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung - interkulturelle Führung Ihre Reise bisher Bildung - Master-Abschluss in Human Resources, Organisationsentwicklung, Business Administration oder verwandten Bereich. Erfahrung - 15+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in Learning & Development, Talent Management oder Organisationsentwicklung. - Bedeutende Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung globaler Lernstrategien für große, internationale Arbeitskräfte. - Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit führenden Talentmanagement- und Nachfolgeplanungsprogrammen für Führungskräfte von Unternehmen. - Erfahrung in Kreuzfahrt, Gastfreundschaft, Reise, Luftfahrt oder anderen großen serviceorientierten Organisationen stark bevorzugt. - Erfahrung in hochgradig multikulturellen und geografisch verteilten Umgebungen. descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le responsable de l'apprentissage et du perfectionnement (à bord et à terre) et de la gestion des talents (à terre) est chargé de définir et de diriger la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement à la fois pour les employés à bord et à terre, tout en surveillant la gestion des talents et la planification de la relève pour les populations à terre seulement. Ce rôle permet à l'entreprise de développer les capacités nécessaires pour offrir aux clients des expériences exceptionnelles, l'excellence opérationnelle et un leadership solide à l'échelle mondiale, y compris des milliers d'équipages de navires et une organisation à terre diversifiée. Pour les employés de bord, le rôle consiste à renforcer les capacités opérationnelles et de service de calibre mondial au moyen d'une formation structurée, d'un perfectionnement en leadership et de cadres de progression de carrière qui appuient le rendement de la flotte et la satisfaction des clients. Pour les employés à terre, le rôle est à la fois responsable de l'apprentissage et du perfectionnement et de la gestion des talents, y compris le perfectionnement du leadership, la planification de la relève et le perfectionnement des talents pour les rôles de leadership organisationnel et opérationnel. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants opérationnels supérieurs de l'ensemble des opérations, de l'expérience des invités et des fonctions ministérielles, ce rôle est à l'origine d'une culture d'apprentissage continu, d'excellence en leadership et de renforcement des capacités organisationnelles dans l'ensemble des opérations mondiales de l'entreprise. Votre impact Stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement (à bord et à terre) - Définir et mettre en oeuvre la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement couvrant à la fois les équipages et les employés à terre. - Élaborer un écosystème d'apprentissage intégré qui appuie l'excellence opérationnelle à bord et la capacité de leadership à terre. - Veiller à ce que les initiatives d'apprentissage appuient directement les priorités stratégiques telles que : - l'excellence de l'expérience des invités - la sécurité et la conformité - le rendement opérationnel - l'efficacité du leadership - la transformation numérique et opérationnelle - Superviser les cadres d'intégration et de perfectionnement afin d'accélérer l'intégration et le rendement des employés à bord et à terre. - Diriger l'adoption d'approches d'apprentissage modernes, y compris l'apprentissage numérique, la formation par simulation, le microapprentissage et les solutions d'apprentissage mixte. Apprentissage et développement à bord des navires - Diriger la conception et la prestation de la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement à bord des navires dans l'ensemble de la flotte. - S'associer étroitement aux opérations maritimes, aux opérations hôtelières, aux aliments et boissons et à la direction de l'Expérience invitée pour s'assurer que les programmes de formation appuient les priorités opérationnelles et l'excellence des services. - Assurer des normes de formation uniformes dans l'ensemble de la flotte tout en tenant compte des réalités opérationnelles des environnements de bord. - Superviser les programmes de perfectionnement pour les rôles clés à bord des navires, y compris les programmes de supervision et de perfectionnement de la gestion pour les futurs dirigeants à bord. - Soutenir des parcours structurés de perfectionnement professionnel pour les équipages de bord, permettant une progression interne entre les fonctions d'accueil et d'exploitation. - Assurer l'alignement sur toutes les exigences en matière de formation réglementaire maritime et les normes de sécurité. Apprentissage et perfectionnement à terre - Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de programmes d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour les employés à terre dans toutes les fonctions ministérielles et opérationnelles. - Élaborer des initiatives de renforcement des capacités à l'appui des priorités clés de l'entreprise, notamment : - les capacités commerciales - la transformation numérique - l'excellence opérationnelle - la culture axée sur les invités - concevoir des programmes structurés de perfectionnement du leadership à l'intention des dirigeants émergents, moyens et supérieurs. - Élaborer des académies fonctionnelles et des cadres de capacités qui appuient les disciplines organisationnelles essentielles. Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only) - Définir et mettre en oeuvre la stratégie globale de gestion des talents pour les employés à terre. - Processus de direction pour : - l'identification des talents et l'examen des talents - la planification de la relève pour les rôles critiques en matière de leadership - les programmes de perfectionnement à fort potentiel - le perfectionnement des cadres de leadership - les cadres de perfectionnement professionnel - le partenariat avec les cadres de direction et les partenaires d'affaires des RH afin d'assurer de solides possibilités de relève pour les postes clés de leadership organisationnel et opérationnel à terre. - Intégrer les pratiques de gestion des talents dans les cadres de gestion du rendement et de perfectionnement du leadership. Développement du leadership - Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des programmes de perfectionnement du leadership à l'appui des populations de leadership à bord des navires et à terre. - Mettre en place un cadre mondial de leadership aligné sur les valeurs de l'entreprise et la culture centrée sur les clients. - Renforcer les capacités de leadership dans des domaines tels que : - le leadership des personnes - la prise de décisions opérationnelles - l'excellence des services - l'innovation et l'amélioration continue - le leadership interculturel Votre voyage jusqu'ici Éducation - Maîtrise en ressources humaines, développement organisationnel, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe. Expérience - 15 ans et plus d'expérience progressive en apprentissage et développement, gestion des talents ou développement organisationnel. - Expérience importante de la conception et de la mise en œuvre de stratégies d'apprentissage à l'échelle mondiale pour les travailleurs internationaux de grande taille. - Expérience éprouvée des programmes de gestion des talents et de planification de la relève à l'intention des groupes de dirigeants ministériels. - Expérience en croisière, en hospitalité, en voyage, en aviation ou dans d'autres grandes organisations axées sur le service. - Expérience de travail dans des environnements très multiculturels et géographiquement répartis. Compétences clés - Apprentissage stratégique et développement des capacités - Gestion des talents et planification de la relève (Corporate) - Excellence en service et hospitalité Culture - Influence des intervenants et partenariat exécutif - Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence - Développement organisationnel - Apprentissage Technologie et apprentissage numérique Vos essentiels - La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise; l'italien, le français, l'allemand ou d'autres langues européennes sont un plus. Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

- Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry.

- Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous.

- Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility.

- Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms.

- Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration.

- Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry.

- Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software).

- Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams.

- International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations.

- Willingness to travel extensively.

Your Essentials

- SWISS Resident or Visa Holder

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.An exciting opportunity exists for a talented Digital Professional to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys. This role is based in the office in Geneva.The Digital Platforms Manager will lead the strategy, development and deployment of our travel App. Your Impact The Digital platforms Manager will: - Lead the strategy of the EJ guest Area including My Explora and our travel App - Design and lead the development of the new App - Define and maintain the Guest Area strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals. - Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for platform management. - Identify opportunities for platforms innovation, optimization, and new capabilities. - Document product features and create user stories - Lead the creation and maintenance of platforms roadmap - Translate complex technical requirements into actionable product specifications - Communicate with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and business stakeholders - Support the testing and release processes for new product updates - Spot, report and follow the resolution & correction of bugs - Monitor product performance metrics and making data-driven decisions - Define KPIs and dashboards to track platform success. Your Journey so far - You have minimum of 8/10 years’ experience in a similar Role preferably in the Luxury or Luxury Hospitality/Travel Industry - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Digital Marketing, or related field. - Experience managing web platforms, mobile apps, or enterprise digital ecosystems. Your Essentials - You set yourself apart through your personal accountability to deliver with excellence - You are structured, well organized and know how to navigate in a matrix organisation - Strong knowledge on the Digital projects lifecycle, particularly on complex or highly technical products - You are a fast learner and tech savvy - Knowledge in Adobe Experience Manager is a plus - Fluent in English At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Il tuo scopo Lead Onboard Casino team tecnici, garantendo operazioni fluide, mantenendo elevati standard di servizio e massimizzando la generazione di ricavi. Come Casino Slot e Technical Operations Manager, sarai responsabile del monitoraggio delle prestazioni delle slot machine, analisi dei dati di gioco e delle strategie di attuazione per migliorare la soddisfazione e la redditività del giocatore. Il vostro ruolo coinvolgerà ispezioni regolari e pianificazione di manutenzione per garantire che tutte le slot machine funzionino correttamente ed efficacemente. Sarete anche responsabili della gestione dell'inventario, dell'ordine di nuove attrezzature, del coordinamento delle installazioni e degli aggiornamenti. Si prevede di rimanere aggiornati sulle tendenze del settore e sulle tecnologie emergenti, adattando attivamente le operazioni per mantenere la conformità e il vantaggio competitivo. Il tuo impatto
• supervisionare tutti i progetti tecnici e partecipare attivamente alla loro attuazione. Mantenere un'eccellente linea di comunicazione con la riva e il reparto tecnico nave per garantire che tutti i progetti del casinò siano dispiegati in base al programma e conformi agli standard tecnici e di sicurezza dell'azienda.
• Assistere con analisi di bilancio, previsione e ricavi.
• Gestire budget, costi di controllo e ottimizzare l'allocazione delle risorse.
• Supporto e guida a bordo del team di gestione del casinò su ogni nave attraverso una comunicazione costante e visite operative regolari delle navi. Discutere le aree di preoccupazione specifiche per l'Operazione e il prodotto specifico del marchio, e allo stesso modo affrontare i punti di encomio.
• Fornire una valutazione accurata e obiettiva delle operazioni e del personale del casinò a bordo.
• Analisi delle entrate, identificazione delle tendenze con la capacità di creare soluzioni strutturate per aumentare o migliorare i flussi di reddito. Esplora nuovi modi per aumentare i ricavi esistenti e /o migliorare le pratiche di lavoro attuali, mantenendo allo stesso tempo un elevato standard tecnico e di sicurezza a bordo delle nostre navi.
• Isolare le aree sotto lo standard con i membri del team di gestione del Casino Shipboard.
• Formazione di tutti i team di gestione in Slot Revenue, Sicurezza e Sorveglianza.
• Confermare che le misure di sicurezza soddisfano i requisiti minimi.
• Fornire assistenza e consulenza per la risoluzione dei problemi tramite e-mail ai team tecnici di bordo.
• Valutare, valutare e rivedere i dati per l'organizzazione di progetti e/o fornire indicazioni su attività, attività o processi secondo le linee guida aziendali. Il tuo viaggio finora
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle operazioni di slot da casinò.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.

- Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.

- Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

Your Essentials

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo La Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing e CRO Manager saranno responsabili della crescita del D2C attraverso la sperimentazione basata sui dati e l'ottimizzazione strategica dei nostri canali digitali diretti. Potrai testare la nostra strategia di test e approfondimenti per massimizzare i tassi di conversione, la prenotazione di volumi e ricavi per visitatore, mentre la costruzione di una pratica di sperimentazione migliore in classe che offre un vantaggio competitivo sostenibile. Questo ruolo avrà una forte attenzione strategica sul canale diretto, ottimizzando la generazione di piombo, e sfruttando intuizioni per guidare l'acquisizione, l'impegno e il valore di vita del cliente più elevato. Il tuo impatto
• Progettare ed eseguire una strategia globale basata sui dati in tutti i punti di contatto digitali, con particolare attenzione alla guida della crescita dei canali diretti e alla riduzione dei costi di acquisizione attraverso un miglioramento dei tassi di conversione.
• Collaborare con team interfunzionali tra cui prodotti, design, ingegneria, marketing e analisi web per concettualizzare e progettare test A/B che misurano efficacemente l'impatto dei cambiamenti del sito web e della campagna.
• Guidare iniziative strategiche all'interno del canale diretto, garantendo un approccio basato sui dati per la generazione di lead, la segmentazione del pubblico e l'ottimizzazione del customer journey per migliorare la conversione e l'impegno.
• Sviluppare approfondimenti di viaggio dei clienti attraverso analisi avanzate, identificare punti di attrito chiave e opportunità per migliorare l'esperienza degli utenti e guidare valori di prenotazione più elevati.
• Eseguire analisi di segmentazione digitale avanzate per scoprire segmenti di clienti di alto valore e opportunità di personalizzazione attraverso l'imbuto di conversione.
• Stabilire strutture di misura robuste per quantificare l'impatto commerciale delle iniziative di ottimizzazione, tra cui la progettazione di test, la previsione dei ricavi e l'analisi post-implementazione.
• Sviluppa dashboard di prestazioni complete che combinano i risultati dei test, le metriche del comportamento del cliente e i KPI commerciali per guidare l'ottimizzazione dei tassi di conversione.
• Guidare l'innovazione nelle strategie di personalizzazione e ottimizzazione per massimizzare il contributo diretto dei canali utilizzando gli strumenti di nuova adozione (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).
• Sviluppare framework di test che bilanciano rapidamente le vincite con iniziative strategiche a lungo termine. Il tuo viaggio finora
• Laurea in business, marketing, analisi o un campo relativo, con 5 anni di esperienza rilevante.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Unisciti a MSC Crociere per un entusiasmante stage focalizzato su analisi, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e generazione di informazioni in due aree strategiche: Customer Journey e il nostro miglior programma.

Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno appassionato di analisi dei dati, generazione di insight e creazione di dashboard, con un forte interesse a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e degli ospiti attraverso un impatto misurabile.

Sosterrai lo sviluppo di analisi strutturate e meccanismi di follow-up, lavorando a stretto contatto con il reparto Customer Journey e HR. Il ruolo fornisce un'esposizione pratica sia agli analytics orientati agli ospiti che ai dipendenti.

Il tuo impatto

Viaggio dei clienti:

- Sostenere le analisi del Customer Journey ricorrenti, incluse le recensioni basate su tela, le analisi della nave di mezza stagione e i responsabili dei comitati.

- Contribuire a analisi approfondite ad hoc su argomenti specifici, segmenti ospiti, nazionalità o navi, in base alle richieste di business e gestione.

- Preparare estrazioni di dati, grafici, tabelle e uscite analitiche di primo livello utilizzando modelli standardizzati.

- Mantenere i tracker di analisi del Customer Journey, assicurando la documentazione corretta, il controllo della versione e il monitoraggio dei piani di azione.

- Supporta analisi e aggiornamenti di follow-up dopo i piloti, modifiche operative o feedback di gestione.

- Assicurare l'accuratezza dei dati, la consistenza e l'allineamento attraverso il Customer Journey consegnabili e reporting.

Il nostro programma BEST:

- Sostenere lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e il monitoraggio dei framework KPI per il nostro programma BEST.

- Consolidare e analizzare i dati provenienti da più fonti, inclusi i sondaggi di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti, il feedback dei nostri clienti, la formazione di NPS e i relativi indicatori degli ospiti.

- Costruire, aggiornare e mantenere le dashboard per monitorare le prestazioni del programma, l'impegno e l'impatto nel tempo.

- Produrre rapporti regolari di performance e riassunti esecutivi strutturati per le recensioni di leadership.

- Assicurare la coerenza dei dati, la precisione e gli standard di report in tutti i nostri output di analisi BEST.

- Sostenere la preparazione di visualizzazioni di dati e materiali di storytelling per gli stakeholder senior.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea (o attualmente iscritta) in Business, Data Analytics, Ospitalità o un campo relativo

- Forte mentalità analitica con attenzione ai dettagli

- Avanzate competenze di Excel; la conoscenza degli strumenti di dashboard (ad esempio Power BI, Tableau) è un plus

- Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di tradurre i dati in insight strutturati

- Fluente in inglese

I tuoi essenziali

Competenze consigliate

- No.
Conoscenza di base delle metriche di soddisfazione degli ospiti e NPS

- No.
Comprensione di base delle metriche di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti

- Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione e reporting dati

- Interessi nel viaggio dei clienti, nell'esperienza degli ospiti e nel miglioramento dei servizi

- Familiarità con l'analisi dei dati dell'indagine e l'analisi a risposta aperta

Cosa ti offre questo ruolo:

- Esperienza pratica nell'analisi, sviluppo KPI e dashboard

- Esposizione all'impatto reale del business attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati

- Opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente globale e dinamico

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. Reporting to the Head of HR, this role partners with senior leaders to translate business priorities into effective people solutions, while ensuring consistent application of Group HR policies, processes, and standards. The Senior HRBP plays a key role in driving performance, engagement, and organisational effectiveness in a complex, international organisation where operational excellence, agility, and customer focus are critical. Your Impact - Act as the primary HR partner for assigned corporate functions, providing strategic advice and operational HR support aligned with business objectives; - Equip leaders with the tools, frameworks, and guidance required to effectively manage their teams in line with Group values and people policies; - Partner with senior leaders to support workforce planning and organisational needs, ensuring capabilities and capacity are aligned with current and future business requirements; - Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to define recruitment needs and support delivery of hiring plans in line with agreed KPIs; - Drive performance and accountability by supporting the implementation of the Group performance management framework, including goal setting, evaluation cycles, and manager capability building; - Support talent management processes within the business perimeter, including talent reviews, identification of high-potential employees, succession discussions, and development actions, in coordination with the Head of HR and relevant Centers of Expertise; - Advise managers on employee relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant people decisions; - Support change management and organisational initiatives by assessing people impact, supporting leaders through transitions, and ensuring clear and effective communication; - Contribute to key HR cycles such as annual compensation reviews, talent reviews, and employee engagement initiatives; - Work closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and HRIS teams to ensure smooth execution of HR processes and digital tools; - Participate in global HR projects and initiatives, contributing business insight and supporting effective local implementation; - Conduct exit interviews, analyse turnover trends, and contribute to retention and engagement actions within the business perimeter. Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; - Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience in a matrixed, multinational environment, including at least 5 -7 years in a Senior HR Business Partner or equivalent role; - Proven HR experience within the hospitality, cruise, travel or customer-centric industry, with a strong understanding of service culture; - Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders in a corporate or headquarters environment; - Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver HR initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and tight timelines; - Solid exposure to performance management, talent processes, employee relations, and organisational support; - Experience working with global HR policies, frameworks, and HR systems (HRIS); - Knowledge of Swiss Labour Law is an advantage; - Fluent in English; French is an advantage. Your Essentials - Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategy into pragmatic HR solutions; - Credible and confident advisor, able to influence, challenge, and build trust with senior stakeholders; - Strong understanding of hospitality and service excellence cultures, with the ability to balance people care, performance, and operational demands; - Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. - Structured, reliable, and comfortable operating across multiple priorities; - Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively across HR functions and with diverse stakeholders; - High standards of integrity, discretion, and professional judgment; - Flexible, resilient, and solution-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni senior operazioni leadership in ospitalità, destinazioni da crociera, resort, porti, parchi a tema o grandi attività di ospitalità. - Proprietà dimostrata delle operazioni pre-apertura e a lungo termine. - Forte background che lavora insieme a team di sviluppo, costruzione e servizi tecnici. - Esperienza in ambienti caraibici o isolati fortemente preferito. Il vostro Essentials - Operazioni di prontezza e di ciclo di vita - Leader della forza lavoro su larga scala - Contabilità finanziaria e P&L - Gestione del ciclo di vita e della manutenzione - Gestione multioperatoria e delle concessioni Il nostro impegno Siamo impegnati a costruire un futuro che valorizza prospettive diverse, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valutato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il loro sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets. The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance. Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter. Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards. Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones. In coordination with Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.), define Procurements needs and implement it. FFE/OWS. Influence design decisions to ensure operational efficiency, safety and maintainability. Establish operating structures, SOPs and governance well ahead of opening. Manage handovers from construction to operations, including phased turnovers. For each project, identify personnel need and -in conjunction with HR- ensure the operational ability of new assets. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce. Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning. Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections. Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far

• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
